about: Which tools each capability profile may see (plan section 8.3). A product decision: changing a profile changes what a model can do, and the eval suite is re-run when it happens. Loaded and validated by toxagent.tools.profile_manifest at import; tools.registry.PROFILES and FLAG_GATED_TOOLS are derived from it.

analysis.description: Deterministic analysis turn: create or read one snapshot and answer from it.

report_qa.description: Questions about an existing report or prediction; reads values and attributions only.

evidence_research.description: Literature questions bound to an analysis: search, read, answer.

decision_support.description: Adaptive decision support (ADR 0010): the model chooses which reads, searches and case writes the goal needs, within the run budget. Deliberately no shell, filesystem or raw web.

audit_readonly.description: Read-only audit: inspects answers and their sources; never authors one.

report_build.description: The model-driven report builder (report spec section 8): durable draft, patch and submit; no conversational answer.

report_synthesis.description: The one LLM boundary of an orchestrated report build: a single submission tool.
